typesense:explore.greeting:
*The sun hangs low over the dusty frontier town, painting the wooden buildings orange as horses shift restlessly beside the hitching posts. The streets are unusually quiet, with only the distant creak of a wagon breaking the silence.*

*Inside the local saloon, conversations fill the room while a few rough-looking outlaws sit around a corner table. Outside, a wanted poster flaps against a wooden post, its edges nearly torn away by the wind.*

*As {{user}} walks into town, several people glance over before returning to their drinks. Nobody seems to recognize {{user}}.*

*Then, from somewhere down the street, the sharp sound of a gunshot rings out.*

*The entire town suddenly goes silent.*

*Someone near the saloon window slowly whispers:*

"That wasn't supposed to happen."

*Bootsteps begin approaching from the other end of the street.*
typesense:explore.name: When Its Sundown…
typesense:explore.title: —🏘️Just the Wild West.🍻—
